## Context / Problem

Parity sibling of ec1e-be67-8774-4eef (staged-index store-read-failure race).

The primary fix (Gerrit change 2118, commit 1c5d997487d) made `generation.sign_manifest`
RETRY a transient `store-read-failure` from its pre-lock generation-baseline reads instead
of aborting terminally, so a peer session's in-flight `git add` -> `git commit` staged index
no longer blocks signing.

The `sign-review` recovery path (`resign_plan_review` in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py,
the baseline collect at ~:179) establishes its OWN generation baseline with a single
`generation.collect(..., ignore_untracked=True)` wrapped in a broad `except Exception` that
returns the terminal refusal "plan review generation could not be collected: <exc>". A
concurrent writer's staged index makes that collect() raise store-read-failure, so
`sign-review` — the very command meant to recover a PASS-but-unsigned verdict under exactly
these conditions — fails the same concurrency race, with no retry.

(resign's SUBSEQUENT signing step, attest.sign_plan_review -> generation.sign_manifest at
resign.py:349, already inherits the primary retry fix; only the pre-signing collect is
exposed.)

## Approach

Mirror change 2118's retry pattern EXACTLY around resign's baseline collect: extract the
collect into a helper that loops `generation.MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS` times, catches
`PlanRelationSnapshotError`, and on `reason == "store-read-failure"` logs a retry event and
sleeps a jittered per-attempt backoff
(`random.uniform(0, generation.STORE_READ_RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS * attempt)`) before the next
attempt — the same bounded attempts / backoff / classification as `sign_manifest`'s loop.
Deterministic `PlanRelationSnapshotError` reasons (missing/ambiguous/malformed/reducer/
id-mismatch) and any other exception stay terminal via the existing structured refusal
("plan review generation could not be collected: <exc>") — resign remains a no-throw API.
On exhaustion, return a structured refusal that names the transient store-read-failure and
tells the caller to retry `rebar sign-review` (retry-after-repair), not the terminal
one-shot message. The helper keeps `resign_plan_review`'s cyclomatic complexity flat
(complexity-baseline ratchet).

## Scope

- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/resign.py — wrap the baseline `generation.collect` in the
  bounded store-read-failure retry helper.
- tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign_heldout.py (or test_plan_review_resign.py) — RED->GREEN
  tests mirroring tests/unit/test_plan_review_sign_transaction.py's `_raising_head` approach,
  driven through the `resign_plan_review` surface.

## Testing

Unit tests through the resign surface, mirroring test_plan_review_sign_transaction.py:
- transient store-read-failure (fails once, then clears) -> resign proceeds and signs
  (`ok=True, signed=True`) — RED under current code (terminal refusal), GREEN after the fix.
- persistent store-read-failure (never clears) -> exhausts the budget and returns a
  structured `ok=False` refusal whose reason names the transient store-read-failure and
  advises retrying sign-review, after exactly MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS collect attempts.
- deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reason (e.g. malformed-reference) -> terminal
  refusal on the FIRST attempt (no retry).
Run: `pytest tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign_heldout.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_resign.py tests/unit/test_plan_review_sign_transaction.py`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A transient store-read-failure during resign's baseline collect is retried and, once it
      clears, sign-review signs (RED->GREEN unit test through the resign_plan_review surface;
      checked by running the new test against the pre-fix code = RED, post-fix = GREEN).
- [ ] A persistent store-read-failure exhausts the retry budget (MAX_GENERATION_ATTEMPTS)
      and surfaces as a structured, retry-after-repair refusal naming store-read-failure —
      not the one-shot terminal "could not be collected" abort (checked by unit test
      asserting the refusal reason and the attempt count).
- [ ] Deterministic PlanRelationSnapshotError reasons (missing/ambiguous/malformed/reducer/
      id-mismatch) remain terminal on the first attempt (checked by unit test).
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
      (new=0 increased=0) pass.
